{{Quote|The Council ''is'' going to demand an explanation as to why one of the most wanted men on Coruscant escaped confinement and slipped through our fingers&hellip; but I've got a feeling we haven't seen the last of him.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Mind uploading''' was the process of copying or transferring a conscious mind from a [[Brain/Legends|brain]] to a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Arlain Zee]] was able to evade capture by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] by downloading his consciousness into [[R5-Q3]].
